messages:
Sarah (Sales): FYI Cobalt wants to kick off a co-sell pilot next week. Need tech/ops sync + answers to pricing and security Qs. Can we coordinate?
Maria L (Partner): great — they're focused on a dedicated POC with SSO + on-prem connector. Timeline 2 weeks for initial eval.
Aj Khan: can we confirm model surface? Are they testing embeddings + chat or just inference?
Sarah (Sales): embeddings + chat. They want cost projection for 10k concurrent users (peak) and a staged canary.
Tim O: for 10k peak we'll recommend Dedicated with burst; ballpark monthly commit depends on GPU class. I'll pull sample perf numbers.
Elena S (Security): Cobalt sent an RRQ (security questionnaire). We need SAML metadata, encryption-at-rest notes, and KMS options. I can draft answers but need the SSO flow doc.
Maria L (Partner): I have their SAML SP metadata. Sharing link: https://cobalt.example.com/saml-metadata.xml
Aj Khan: for the on-prem connector they asked about network requirements — we should provide CIDR/IPs + outbound ports. I can attach a short runbook.
Tim O: Action items: 1) I will produce perf/cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. 2) Aj to publish network runbook (sample config + ports). 3) Elena to start RRQ draft. 4) Maria to upload SAML metadata/profile and sample dataset (anonymized).
Sarah (Sales): timeline: kickoff Tue 10am PT. Can we do a 30m tech pre-brief Mon to align?
Maria L (Partner): Mon 4pm PT works for me.
Aj Khan: +1, I'll bring the runbook draft.
Elena S (Security): I'll add the KMS/HSM options and audit log samples to the RRQ answers.
DeployBot: deploy queued for infra branch "partner-poc-docs" — status: pending -> will not affect this thread.
Tim O: Also note: recommend prefix/KV caching enabled for chat to reduce token cost; include suggested batching config: `batch_size: 32, max_latency_ms: 15`.
Sarah (Sales): perfect. I'll send calendar invites and Cobalt contact. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria L (Partner): I'll also request their legal point to start an MSA draft if POC looks good.
Aj Khan: leaving checklist here: network runbook link, SAML metadata, perf estimate, RRQ draft, demo data upload. I'll keep an issue in GH and tag the team.
Elena S (Security): ping me on the RRQ PR for quick review.
Sarah (Sales): last ask from Cobalt: pricing flexibility for pilot — can we offer 30% pilot discount on committed capacity? finance ok with a pilot rate, I think.
Tim O: tentative yes but need CFO ok; I'll loop in finance in the invite.
Maria L (Partner): thanks — see you all Monday.
